# Resource: stripe_coupon

A discount that can be applied to a customer or subscription. `terraform destroy` deletes the coupon, which stops new redemptions and leaves existing discounts in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stripe_coupon" "launch" {
  name        = "Launch offer"
  percent_off = 25
  duration    = "repeating"

  duration_in_months = 3
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are optional:

* `amount_off` - (Optional) A positive integer representing the amount to subtract from an invoice total (required if `percent_off` is not passed). Changing it replaces the resource.
* `applies_to` - (Optional) A hash containing directions for what this Coupon will apply discounts to. Changing it replaces the resource. See [`applies_to`](#applies_to) below.
* `currency` - (Optional) Three-letter [ISO code for the currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies) of the `amount_off` parameter (required if `amount_off` is passed). Changing it replaces the resource.
* `currency_options` - (Optional) Coupons defined in each available currency option (only supported if `amount_off` is passed). Each key must be a three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html) and a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies). See [`currency_options`](#currency_options) below.
* `duration` - (Optional) Specifies how long the discount will be in effect if used on a subscription. Defaults to `once`. Possible values: `forever`, `once`, `repeating`. Changing it replaces the resource.
* `duration_in_months` - (Optional) Required only if `duration` is `repeating`, in which case it must be a positive integer that specifies the number of months the discount will be in effect. Changing it replaces the resource.
* `id` - (Optional) Unique string of your choice that will be used to identify this coupon when applying it to a customer. If you don't want to specify a particular code, you can leave the ID blank and we'll generate a random code for you. Changing it replaces the resource.
* `max_redemptions` - (Optional) A positive integer specifying the number of times the coupon can be redeemed before it's no longer valid. For example, you might have a 50% off coupon that the first 20 readers of your blog can use. Changing it replaces the resource.
* `metadata` - (Optional) Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to `metadata`.
* `name` - (Optional) Name of the coupon displayed to customers on, for instance invoices, or receipts. By default the `id` is shown if `name` is not set.
* `percent_off` - (Optional) A positive float larger than 0, and smaller or equal to 100, that represents the discount the coupon will apply (required if `amount_off` is not passed). Changing it replaces the resource.
* `redeem_by` - (Optional) Unix timestamp specifying the last time at which the coupon can be redeemed (cannot be set to more than 5 years in the future). After the redeem_by date, the coupon can no longer be applied to new customers. Changing it replaces the resource.

<a id="applies_to"></a>
### `applies_to`

The `applies_to` attribute supports:

* `products` - (Optional) A list of product IDs this coupon applies to

<a id="currency_options"></a>
### `currency_options`

The `currency_options` attribute is a map. Each value supports:

* `amount_off` - (Required) Amount (in the `currency` specified) that will be taken off the subtotal of any invoices for this customer.

## Attribute Reference

This resource exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `id` - The Stripe ID of the object.
* `created` - Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `times_redeemed` - Number of times this coupon has been applied to a customer.
* `valid` - Taking account of the above properties, whether this coupon can still be applied to a customer.

## Timeouts

[Configuration options](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/syntax#operation-timeouts) are set with the `timeouts` attribute, for example `timeouts = { create = "5m" }`:

* `create` - (Default `20m`)
* `delete` - (Default `20m`)
* `update` - (Default `20m`)

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, and in OpenTofu, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import a coupon using its ID. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_coupon.launch
  id = "launch_offer"
}
```

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, and in OpenTofu v1.12.0 and later, the `import` block can use the `identity` attribute instead. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_coupon.launch
  identity = {
    id = "launch_offer"
  }
}
```

### Identity Schema

#### Required

* `id` (String) The Stripe ID of the coupon.

Using `terraform import`, import a coupon using its ID. For example:

```console
% terraform import stripe_coupon.launch launch_offer
```
